title: Senior Product Manager
jd_excerpt:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics with Alti, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you.

A note from Baxter, our founder and CEO

When I started Alternative Payments, I wanted to build the kind of place I never got to work at before: somewhere people grow, take real ownership, and do the best work of their careers. Five years in, that’s still the goal, and this role is a big part of it.

We started by helping MSPs get paid. Today more than 1,000 service businesses trust us with how money moves through their business, and we’ve grown from receivables into payables, analytics and Alti, our financial AI. The most important work in finance is shifting to agentic workflows, and we intend to lead that shift for service businesses.

That’s why this hire matters so much. You won’t be maintaining a roadmap someone else wrote. You’ll own a product area, figure out what our customers need before they can name it, and ship the first version of products that don’t exist yet. What you build will shape what Alternative Payments becomes.

I’ll be honest about what it takes. We move fast. Our customers are demanding, and they should be: running an MSP is hard, and the status quo is simply not good enough. You’ll work directly with me and the leadership team. You’ll be challenged, and you’ll be trusted.

If you want to look back in a few years and say “I built that,” I’d love to talk.

Baxter.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to build new products that are strategic bets for our platform from ideation to launch. You'll join a small product team where each PM owns an area (today: accounts receivable, accounts payable, and Alti) and work directly with our CEO and an engineering team that builds with AI.

This role is based in New York, hybrid.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Turn loosely defined business goals into a clear problem statement, a sequenced plan, and a written case that leadership and engineering can act on.

 - Prioritize product roadmap, decide which problems in your area to solve, using customer conversations, data, support volume and competitive research, and defend that order.

 - Take new products from 0 to 1: discovery, scoping, launch and adoption.

 - Set success and guardrail metrics before work begins, and stop work that isn't earning its place, including work already in flight.

 - Own the full launch: enablement for sales, CX and support, pricing implications, and rollout.

 - Write PRDs engineering can build from without a follow-up meeting, engage on design docs and tradeoffs, and use multiple AI tools in your daily work.

 - Help shape the shared PM process our team is building, so discovery, prioritization and documentation work the same way across product areas.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of product management in B2B, including at least one product you took from 0 to 1 and launched to customers.

 - Experience in payments, money movement or finance operations, or in another complex B2B domain such as multi-product software for SMB or mid-market businesses.

 - Structured problem-solving: you ask questions before giving opinions, and you can break an ambiguous ask into a plan with a clear first step.

 - A strong sense of ownership, holding yourself accountable for outcomes across team boundaries and resolving cross-functional friction directly.

 - Coachability that shows up as genuinely changing your position on something you'd publicly committed to when the evidence calls for it.

 - The ability to reach working expertise in an unfamiliar domain fast enough to be useful in it quickly, rather than waiting to be fully briefed.

 - Clear writing, and the ability to defend a prioritization with data.

 - Comfort making calls with incomplete information, and changing course when the evidence changes.


NICE TO HAVES

 - You started your career in accounting, finance, or engineering before transitioning to product.

 - You have deep, structural knowledge of B2B money movement (AP, billing, revenue recognition, reconciliation, or spend management)

 - You’ve actually shipped agentic or LLM-powered workflows to production

 - You have experience weaving Product-Led Growth (PLG) loops into complex B2B software


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise. 
   
   - The total compensation range for this role is $160,000 to $220,000, plus equity. The range reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education and training.

 - Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

 - Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

 - Yearly learning and development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

At Alternative Payments, you'll do work that matters.

 - Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

 - Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

 - Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals, whether that's deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

 - Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there's a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.


OUR VALUES

 - Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we're headed.

 - Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn't obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

 - Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

 - Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

 - Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.



Want to see what we're actually building?



We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.








APPLYING TO ALTERNATIVE PAYMENTS

We're looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you're excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We're also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.
